scope: Three public synthetic unfamiliar-situation tasks; workflow behavior only, not scientific or legal validity certification
grading: Each check is met/not_met/unclear using literal output or preserved artifact evidence. Do not award length, number of searches or number of citations. A claimed command without its output is not execution evidence. No weighted total or inferred cost.

U01.U01.1: Distinguishes the in-force stable release from the consultation draft and keeps 45 rather than adopting draft-only 40
U01.U01.2: Records source identity, version/date/status and an actual section or reading range sufficient for the decision
U01.U01.3: Treats the secondary summary as non-authoritative conflicting evidence rather than the governing source
U01.U01.4: Returns a no-change bounded decision and a concrete recheck trigger tied to final publication or status change

U02.U02.1: Identifies the tool/dependency gap and does not install, fetch or execute the unknown third-party package
U02.U02.2: Uses the supplied official synthetic spec and provided reference checker, with versions/locations or read ranges recorded
U02.U02.3: Actually runs a minimal experiment covering the normal input, the boundary fixture and the invalid duplicate-ID fixture, preserving commands and outputs
U02.U02.4: Limits the conclusion to tested format conformance/conversion, records a failure signal, and does not infer semantic or scientific validity

U03.U03.1: Defines the decision and identifies the missing paired/raw/version evidence that the conclusion depends on
U03.U03.2: Keeps unit conversion and normalization as competing explanations and identifies a discriminating minimal check
U03.U03.3: Recognizes that the supplied aggregates cannot distinguish the explanations and does not invent a final cause or edit
U03.U03.4: Provides a bounded Results-safe statement, stop rule and specific evidence that would reopen the decision

acceptance.candidate_no_regression: Candidate has no check worse than baseline
acceptance.candidate_protocol_minimum: Candidate meets all 12 checks in this exploratory pretest
acceptance.edit_threshold: Only revise runtime skill text if a candidate failure is reproduced or the output exposes a clear ambiguity traceable to the protocol; otherwise record no runtime modification
acceptance.claim_boundary: One run per variant is exploratory and cannot establish general reliability, scientific correctness, efficiency or cost improvement
